title: Zesty Dense Slovakian Meat Stew
description: A hearty and dense Slovakian stew made with fermented ingredients and dashi, perfect for a cold winter night. This Whole30-friendly dish is cooked in one pot and features a rich salt-bake flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef short ribs until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the ribs from the pot and set them aside.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the dashi powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the fermented sauerkraut and browned short ribs back to the pot, stirring to combine.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
